fields.label: View Full
fields.description: View complete stored Phone and Mobile numbers.

fields.label: Edit Existing
fields.description: Correct or replace existing stored numbers. Does not grant full-number visibility.

fields.label: New Patient Entry
fields.description: Enter customer-provided numbers when creating a Patient. Does not reveal existing numbers.

fields.label: Add Number
fields.description: Add a customer-provided contact number while preserving existing numbers.

fields.label: Set Primary
fields.description: Choose the primary Mobile and Phone from contact rows. Existing numbers remain masked unless View Full is granted.
